contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANT INVS [---]AVG ; R/ GLOR IAEXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constantine I (306-337), if so, a Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-337, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANT INVS [---]AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; the standard bears a side handle and three discs below a house-shaped flag or vexillum…
